title: Compile budget: GMCP serves MCP without the rmcp SDK
goal: Take the rmcp MCP server SDK (and its macro, schemars and sse-stream crates) out of the core build by serving GMCP's MCP protocol with GMCP's own implementation in crates/susi-gmcp/src/mcp: the wire model, JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes with the same parse strictness, the initialize and 2026-07-28 per-request lifecycles (server/discover), tools/list pagination, tools/call with progress, cancellation, tasks and multi-round-trip input, resources, prompts, completion, logging and subscriptions, over the existing stdio gate and Streamable HTTP (sessions, SSE with priming events and keep-alive, stateless 2026-07-28 requests, Mcp-* header checks, Host and Origin validation) on the tokio/hyper transport GMCP already runs. Built-in tool definitions come from a declarative tool_def! macro and input_schema! struct declarations that reproduce the previous inputSchema JSON exactly. susi-vendor-mcp-server is deleted; behaviour on the wire is unchanged (stdio and HTTP transcripts recorded before and after are identical).
acceptance: cargo test -p susi --test gmcp_requirements --test mcp_call_cli_tests --offline --locked passes (every GMCP requirement and mastery check on the committed evidence, and the MCP command-line suite against the served stdio and HTTP surfaces).
